skill.displayName: AI Group Photo Generator – Create Group Photo Collages Online – CLI-powered
skill.summary: AI group photo generator — create a creative group photo or collage from up to 10 images

latestVersion.changelog:
ai-group-photo-generator-cli-skill v1.0.0 — Initial release

- Generate creative group photos or collages from up to 10 images using the CLI.
- Supports custom prompts or a detailed avant-garde collage default prompt.
- Requires installation of weshop-cli and a WESHOP_API_KEY environment variable.
- Outputs URLs to generated group photo images.
- Clear API key security guidance and setup instructions included.
